title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Design-Aware Code Review in the Linux Kernel
abstract: arXiv:2610.21925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code review often requires reasoning beyond local correctness. In mature software systems, reviewers must recognize design trade-offs introduced by a proposed change, compare alternative solutions, and reason about their compatibility with project-specific constraints. We refer to this problem as design-aware code review. However, existing automated review approaches primarily focus on defects and correctness, while the design knowledge accumulated in historical review discussions remains difficult to reuse.   To address these challenges, we present DesignLore, a knowledge-augmented approach that extracts design decisions from historical review discussions, organizes them into an adaptive design taxonomy, and reuses relevant historical knowledge to guide code review. translated_title: 基准测试与增强Linux内核中的设计感知代码审查
translated_abstract: 代码审查往往需要超越局部正确性的推理。在成熟的软件系统中，审查者必须识别所提议变更引入的设计权衡，比较备选解决方案，并推理其与项目特定约束的兼容性。我们将这一问题称为“设计感知代码审查”。然而，现有的自动化审查方法主要关注缺陷和正确性，而历史审查讨论中积累的设计知识仍然难以复用。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DesignLore，这是一种知识增强方法，它从历史审查讨论中提取设计决策，将其组织成自适应的设计分类体系，并复用相关的历史知识来指导代码审查。我们进一步构建了DesignReviewBench，这是一个源自真实补丁审查历史的基准，用于系统地评估设计感知代码审查。我们的评估表明……
tldr: 本文提出了DesignLore知识增强方法和DesignReviewBench基准，通过从历史审查讨论中提取、组织并复用设计决策知识，系统性评估并增强了Linux内核中的设计感知代码审查。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DesignLore, a knowledge-augmented approach, along with DesignReviewBench, a benchmark built from real patch-review histories, to systematically evaluate and enhance design-aware code review in the Linux kernel by extracting, organizing, and reusing design decisions from historical review discussions.
